quotes.text: The import wizard passes errorMsgObj.value to a Fluent message on failed key import. Bug 1874715 made this value an empty string when absent because an undefined error variable caused a Rust Fluent crash. keyRing also fills errorMsgObj on failure. The landed and current wizard preserve the empty-string fallback for this message. This is a boundary contract between import result and localization, not a general instruction to hide errors.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
